title: SMB versus enterprise agency client fees, same delivery scope
tooltip: Estimated from industry standard cost projection methods 2026.
method: Same phase-one workstream hours and delivery scope for both offers. Enterprise pricing unchanged. SMB uses a separately modeled fully loaded client rate card for a pooled-specialist standard-scope fixed-fee offer. No second profit markup, automatic company-size discount, or reduced deliverable/governance scope.
